gates.name: Detector/model/parser/config/driver freeze
gates.pass_condition: Exact commit and hashes frozen before source selection, scan, and label access.

gates.name: Development/holdout disjointness
gates.pass_condition: Auditable repository, commit/tree, blob/content, known-case, and fixture exclusion against D1-D54 and all tuning data.

gates.name: Target population and selection frame
gates.pass_condition: Population, time window, eligible units, strata, seed, and selection probabilities preregistered without conditioning on scanner output.

gates.name: Eligibility and frozen denominator
gates.pass_condition: All include/exclude, generated/vendor/test, language, duplicate, symlink/submodule, unavailable-object rules defined; eligible manifest/hash frozen.

gates.name: Label unit and evidence rubric
gates.pass_condition: Operational positive, negative, unrelated, unknown labels with support and counterevidence requirements.

gates.name: Reviewer independence and blinding
gates.pass_condition: Independent reviewers do not see prediction/severity/confidence before initial labels; access and role are documented.

gates.name: Double review and adjudication
gates.pass_condition: Independent labels preserved; disagreement adjudicated independently; nonresponse and unknown retained.

gates.name: Candidate and no-hit review
gates.pass_condition: Candidates sampled/reviewed for precision and no-hit eligible units probability-sampled or exhaustively audited for recall; weights defined.

gates.name: Estimands and denominators
gates.pass_condition: Finding/file units separated; precision/recall denominator formulas predeclared; unknowns counted and sensitivity treatment stated.

gates.name: Uncertainty and design effects
gates.pass_condition: Sample sizes and design-appropriate intervals/weights reported; unknowns/disagreement reflected; no point-estimate-only claims.

gates.name: Stopping/inconclusive rules
gates.pass_condition: Minimum coverage, thresholds, stratum underfill, missing labels, instability, stop and claim scope preregistered before labels.

gates.name: Independent recomputation artifacts
gates.pass_condition: Raw outputs, hashes, frame/seed, blinded labels, adjudication, and metric scripts retained and independently reproducible.

decision_rules: All core protocol gates must PASS for READY_TO_RUN.
Any holdout contamination or prediction exposure before initial labels invalidates the holdout for the claimed detector version.
Unknown frame, no-hit review, coverage, or denominator prevents an accuracy claim.
M2 evidence sufficiency requires completed frozen scan, independent labels, reconciled accounting, uncertainty, and preregistered thresholds met.
This protocol does not establish M3 product applicability or vulnerability.
unknowns: D55 detector/model/parser bundle freeze timing and hashes
Content-level holdout separation from prior development material
Target population, strata, sample frame, seed, inclusion probabilities
Label unit, independent reviewer roles, blindness, double review, adjudication, unknown treatment
No-hit sample design sufficient for recall estimand
Coverage denominators, uncertainty method, sample-size rationale, stopping thresholds, runtime/RSS procedure
authoring_prompt: Author a D55 preregistered M2 protocol and JSON companion only. Do not modify scanner/models/tests/fixtures/expected outputs; do not generate, inspect, or reveal holdout labels or anticipated outcomes. Audit D5 readiness and D41/D48/T51/T52; treat all listed profiles and examples as previously exposed unless content-level checks prove disjointness. Freeze and hash detector/model/parser/dependencies/config/path filters/driver before selection or exposure. Define population/frame, eligibility, content-level split audit, strata/seed/inclusion probabilities, label units/rubric, independent blind reviewers, double review/adjudication, candidate and probability-sampled or exhaustive no-hit review, unknown/nonresponse policy, reconciled coverage accounting, estimands/denominators, design-appropriate intervals, sample-size rationale, stopping/inconclusive rules, runtime/RSS, audit artifacts, and claim boundaries. Do not equate partial/blocked/not-analyzed/unlabeled with negative. Do not invent missing values; list unknowns. T54 independently reviews the frozen D55 artifact against the checklist; any post-label protocol change requires a fresh holdout or an exploratory-only classification.
